title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Usalama shuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the maudhui with the right term, proves each point with a line or event from "Kisima cha Matumaini", and says what it does in the work.

floor.prerequisite: Answers comprehension questions from a passage.
floor.question: Jibu linatoka wapi?

representations: the class novela "Kisima cha Matumaini" with key pages marked
steps: Read the question and the term.
Find the part of the work.
Write the point with its evidence.
contexts: a school drama or poetry festival

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes one point with its evidence and its importance in the frame.

misconceptions.ask: Huu ni suala lililozungumziwa au ni lengo la mwandishi?
misconceptions.repair: Maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa; dhamira ni lengo la mwandishi.
Anwani hutaja kazi; maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa ndani yake.
Tukio huonyesha maudhui; si maudhui lenyewe.

listen_for: kutuhimiza tuende kanisani au msikitini kila wiki
misconceptions.ask: Ni sehemu gani ya kazi inaonyesha hili?
misconceptions.repair: Dhamira lazima itokane na kazi yenyewe.

checks.question: Katika "Kisima cha Matumaini", "kuonya jamii dhidi ya ufisadi na kuhimiza ujasiri" ni maudhui au dhamira?
Ni ipi ni maudhui katika "Kisima cha Matumaini"?
